name: Sugarloaf Key RV Resort & Cottages
note: Formerly Lazy Lakes RV Resort, then Sun Outdoors Sugarloaf Key until it went independent in April 2025. RV sites line a 7-acre saltwater lake. Winter (Dec 1 - Mar 31 check-ins) takes 7 nights minimum; single nights sell the rest of the year. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site sugarloafkeyrvresort.com read 2026-10-30: full-hookup 20/30/50-amp RV sites in five types (Lakefront Back In, Premium Back In, Premium Cabana Back In, Premium Pull Thru, Waterfront Back In), open year round, Class A/B/C motorhomes, 5th wheels and travel trailers admitted, phone 305-745-1079, Campspot booking (campspot.com/book/sugarloaf-key-rv-resort-and-cottages); Campspot API read 2026-10-30 lists 36 RV sites sold by the night (Lakefront 17 to 45 ft, Cabana 8 and Pull Thru 10 to 42 ft) and sold one night on Oct 20 and Nov 10/24/30 2026 and May/Jun/Jul 2027; Good Sam directory: RV_PARK, Good Sam Park; Google Maps open, 4.5/482, phone matches; 2025 trade press (RV PRO 2025-04-18) says it left the Sun Outdoors brand on 2025-04-15 under Blue Water -> real transient RV resort, not a Sun park, not the KOA (id 15422, a separate park 630 m NE on the bay); price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator sells 'Lakefront Back In FHU' sites and describes the resort as on a seven-acre saltwater lake; that only triggered the audit. Esri satellite (sat.py, all rendered: 1.2 km frame at 24.6575,-81.5200, 300 m frame at 24.6553,-81.5220, 90 m frames at 24.6559,-81.5221 and 24.6544,-81.5221) shows an enclosed rectangular saltwater pond of about 110 x 250 m (an old borrow pit in the salt flats, not connected to the bay; Upper Sugarloaf Sound is about 600 m E beyond mangroves and the KOA). The east row of RV pads on the park's west side backs onto the pond's west bank: gravel pads end 3-8 m from the waterline, behind a one-shrub-deep mangrove/buttonwood fringe with gaps where the gravel reaches the bank (e.g. the SE corner pad by the pier). That fringe is not a buffer of any depth, so those back-in pads are on the water. The interior rows sit behind them across the park road, and the south shore is cottages, not RV sites. Not bayfront/bayview: no RV site faces open bay or a canal.
fees_source: Campspot API (park sugarloaf-key-rv-resort-and-cottages, via campspot_api.py/campspot_dates.py), read 2026-10-30, 2 adults: every RV night carries a mandatory $15 'Resort Fee High' surcharge. Cheapest type a 23-ft motorhome fits (Premium Pull Thru FHU, to 42 ft) on Tue Jan 26 2027: $202.80 + $15 = $217.80 before 12.5% tax; dearest fitting type (Premium Cabana Back In FHU) on Tue Feb 9 2027: $262.80 + $15 = $277.80. Dec 1 2026: Pull Thru $169 + $15. Summer: Pull Thru Tue Jun 8 2027 $135.45 + $15; Jul 13 2027 $86.90 + $15. The only cheaper type, Premium Back In FHU (1 site, $149-164 in winter), is listed for rigs to 20 ft and does not fit EKKO.

booking.note: Campspot refuses fewer than 7 nights on every RV type EKKO fits for check-ins from December 1 through March 31; single nights sell on November 30 and April 1. Monthly peak-season sites (Dec 1 - Mar 31) are booked by phone, 443-664-3375.

booking_source: Campspot availability API read 2026-10-30 (campspot_dates.py): RESERVATION_MIN_RULE 'There is a 7 night minimum over the requested period of time' on Lakefront, Cabana and Pull Thru for 1- and 2-night stays on Dec 1, Dec 8 2026, Jan 12, Jan 26, Feb 9, Mar 9, Mar 30, Mar 31 2027; 7-night stays on those dates available; 1-night stays available on Nov 10, Nov 24, Nov 30 2026 and Apr 1, Apr 6, May 11, Jul 13 2027.
flags: Sun question settled by address and pin: this is the same park as Sun Outdoors Sugarloaf Key (ex-Lazy Lakes RV Resort), 311 Johnson Rd, Summerland Key. But it left the Sun Outdoors brand on 2025-04-15: Blue Water (which bought Lazy Lakes 'in partnership with Sun Outdoors') rebranded it as an independent resort it runs itself (RV PRO 2025-04-18, Modern Campground 2025-04-22). No source says whether Sun still holds an ownership stake. I treated it as not a Sun park; if AWH counts a former Sun joint venture as Sun, it is a brand skip. Its rules page is a copy of Sun's (it names Sun's Orange City and Arbor Terrace communities), and Campspot's park record still links sunoutdoors.com.
Not a duplicate of Sugarloaf Key / Key West KOA (15422): the KOA is a separate park at 251 State Road 939 on the bay, 630 m NE of this pin; Good Sam lists both separately.

Seasonal minimum: 7 nights for check-ins Dec 1 - Mar 31 (4 months) on every RV type EKKO fits. Outside that window single nights sell. I kept it under the time-of-year rule (AWH 2026-10-19; Quartzsite 7 nights Sep-Dec was restored). A 7-night minimum is not a monthly-only rule, but it runs longer than the 3-month peak-season limit. If AWH applies that limit to it, it is a drop.
Cheapest in-season night a 23-ft rig fits is $217.80 before 12.5% tax ($202.80 Premium Pull Thru + $15 mandatory resort fee, Tue Jan 26 2027); Dec 2026 is $184; summer $102-150.

Long-stay mix: Campspot sells 36 RV sites by the night. Trade press counts 56-65 RV sites in all. Peak-season monthly rates exist, and February's monthly sites are sold out. That is well over 1 in 10 nightly. No homes or lots are sold.
Rig rules: Class A/B/C, 5th wheels and travel trailers allowed; units 10+ years old are inspected by a manager before entry (EKKO is a 2023, so this does not apply).
Good Sam Park (isGsPark true) per the Good Sam directory cache, RV_PARK type, not a condo park.
RV Life lists it unrated with $$$$ (avg_rate $135).
